title: A power design contract carried an extra month until the Commission corrected it

beats.text: A delayed notice changed a power design contract before work began.

visual.sub: A late notice moved the signed end date

beats.text: The signed agreement ended one month after the date commissioners approved.

visual.kicker: A late notice moved the signed end date

visual.label: A late notice moved the signed end date

beats.text: The next extension carried that extra month forward.

visual.kicker: The mismatch carried into the next amendment

beats.text: It added five years to the agreement.
The spending ceiling separately increased to $7,500,000 in 2016.

visual.label: The mismatch carried into the next amendment

beats.text: In 2019 the Commission corrected the earlier mismatch.

visual.kicker: Commissioners corrected the original term in 2019

beats.text: It also authorized five further months.

visual.kicker: Commissioners corrected the original term in 2019

beats.text: The Board later brought the spending ceiling to $11,500,000.

visual.label: The fourth amendment increased the ceiling

beats.text: The signed change identifies when the agreement ended.

visual.kicker: The fourth amendment increased the ceiling
